note: Complete independently printed 64-letter ACA worked example, visually checked before implementation. ENIGMA's alphabetical column ranks generate the primer, which is extended by adjacent chain addition modulo ten. Each six-letter group starts the mixed cipher alphabet at its next keyword letter. The printed leading primer and trailing check digit are framing, not encrypted letters. This certifies supplied-key decryption only. The implementation explicitly supports keywords with 2 through 9 distinct letters and assumes no convention for wider decimal ranks.
